tagline: House Cleaning & Maid Service in the Back Mountain

why_choose_us.title: One maid. Same maid. Every time.
why_choose_us.description: You are not assigned whoever happens to be free that week. The same cleaner learns your home, your preferences, and the corners you actually care about — and comes back to it.

why_choose_us.title: Bonded, insured, and screened
why_choose_us.description: Every team member goes through a thorough screening before they set foot in a home, and we carry company-provided workers' compensation on all of them. You are covered, and so are they.

why_choose_us.title: A published list, not a vague promise
why_choose_us.description: Every service tier has a written, line-by-line checklist — down to switch plates, drip pans, and baseboards. You know exactly what is included before we start.

why_choose_us.title: Free in-home estimate first
why_choose_us.description: We look at your home, then quote it. No hourly guessing, no one-size-fits-all package, and no number that changes once the crew is standing in your kitchen.
